source_title: SKKU BSc Economics Link Agreement, Year One 2025-26
question: For the SKKU BSc Economics link agreement, what is required to pass Year One?
expected_answer: To pass Year One and proceed to the next Year a student must pass all modules and achieve 60 credits in the Year at Level 5 or above. A student may alternatively be allowed to proceed following an attempt at reassessment.
follow_up_question: What happens if they carry a failed non-core module?
follow_up_expected_answer: If the module aggregate is below the pass mark the student may proceed to the Final Year carrying the failed non-core credits, subject to the reassessment rules in the same document.

source_title: Colchester Institute Undergraduate Rules of Assessment 2025-26
question: Which undergraduate courses do the Colchester Institute rules of assessment cover?
expected_answer: BA (Hons) Fine Art, BA (Hons) Graphic Design, BA (Hons) Fashion & Textiles and BA (Hons) 3D Design & Craft, under the Academic Partnerships undergraduate rules of assessment for Colchester Institute.
follow_up_question: How is a resubmitted module marked there?
follow_up_expected_answer: If the pre-resubmission module aggregate was under the pass mark the aggregate can improve up to the pass mark only; if it was over the pass mark the aggregate is capped at the pre-submission aggregate.
follow_up_keyphrases: up to the pass mark only

source_title: Laksamana College of Business Undergraduate Rules of Assessment
question: At Laksamana College of Business, how does a student achieve a Distinction in Year One?
expected_answer: Either a Year Mark of 70 or above, or 60 credits at 70 or above together with a Year Mark of 68 or 69.
follow_up_question: How many non-core credits can be condoned in Year Two there?
follow_up_expected_answer: Condonement may be permitted in up to 30 non-core credits in Year Two.

question: What are the rules of assessment for the MSc Periodontology Science and Practice run with Alexandria?
expected_answer: It is a full-time 12-month Masters programme. The pass mark for all modules is 50, a core module must be taken and passed with no condonement of marks below a pass allowed, and the degree can be awarded with Distinction or Merit, with the Board of Examiners determining whether the criteria for an award have been satisfied.
follow_up_question: Can it be awarded with Distinction?
follow_up_expected_answer: Yes - all Masters degrees under these rules can be awarded with Distinction or Merit, and it is for the Board of Examiners to determine whether the criteria for an award have been satisfied.

source_title: UG Three-Year Honours Degree, Year One Rules
question: For a three-year Essex honours degree, what is required to pass Year One?
expected_answer: The Essex three-year honours degree Year One rules apply - a student must meet the credit and mark requirements set out there, and may proceed to Year Two carrying failed non-core credits where the rules allow. The answer should come from the University's own rules, not a partner institution's edition.
follow_up_question: Can any of those failed credits be condoned?
follow_up_expected_answer: Condonement is available within the limits set by the Essex undergraduate rules of assessment for non-core modules.

question: What is the pass mark and condonement rule for the Essex MSc Periodontology?
expected_answer: The pass mark for all modules of the Masters degree is 50, and a core module must be taken as part of the programme structure and passed, with no condonement of marks below a pass allowed. The answer should come from the Essex edition rather than the Alexandria partner edition.
